$comment: Historical flags for scenario powers, keyed by the scenario-local code in tools/data/scenarios/*.json. Downloaded from Wikimedia Commons by tools/download_scenario_flags.py into data/flags/, rendered to PNG by prerender_problematic_flags.py, and licence-audited by audit_flag_licenses.py exactly like the modern flags. A power with no entry here falls back to a procedural pattern, which is fine for an occupation administration and poor for a great power.

flags.RUS_SFSR: Flag of the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (1918–1925).svg
flags.CHN_ROC: Flag of the Republic of China.svg
flags.CHN_PRC: Flag of the People's Republic of China.svg
flags.CCP: Flag of the Chinese Communist Party.svg
flags.MNG_1945: Flag of the Mongolian People's Republic (1945–1992).svg
